description: Search pinned robot code across robots and runtimes. Results distinguish prepared recipes from upstream references; source discovery is not runtime verification.

q.description: Default all_terms: all query terms must match word prefixes. Standalone A*, D* and RRT* are read as astar, dstar and rrtstar; embedded identifiers and repeated stars keep ordinary tokenization. Empty q browses.

query_mode.description: task opts into ASCII English lexical ranking over at most512 hard-filtered records; narrow runtime/robot when query_too_broad. No execution or compatibility inference.

name: find_robot_skills
